description:
£160 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to welcome this stunning six-bedroom student property to the rental market.

Recently refurbished to a high standard, this fantastic property offers stylish and modern accommodation in the heart of West Jesmond, one of Newcastle-s most sought-after student locations.

Ideally situated just a two-minute walk from West Jesmond Metro station, the property provides excellent transport links and easy access to a range of local amenities, including popular coffee shops, restaurants, bars and independent businesses.

The property boasts six well-proportioned bedrooms, providing comfortable accommodation for a group of students, alongside two bathrooms for added convenience. There is also street parking available.

Combining contemporary interiors with an unbeatable location, this property is an excellent choice for students looking for high-quality accommodation close to everything West Jesmond has to offer.

Early viewing is highly recommended to avoid disappointment. To arrange a viewing, contact My Property Box today and speak to our dedicated Lettings Team!
